data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in Australia, I'd put **Stripe, Shopify Payments and Square** at the top of the list.

My recommendation depends mainly on what platform your store uses, how much you sell, and whether you want the simplest setup or the lowest transaction costs.

Here's how I'd compare them.

## Best payment processors compared

| Provider | Best for | Main advantage |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Stripe | (Best overall) | Flexible, reliable, easy integrations |
| Shopify Payments | Shopify stores | Built directly into Shopify |
| Square | Small businesses selling online and in person | Simple setup and management |
| PayPal | Additional checkout option | Familiar and trusted by shoppers |
| Airwallex | International stores | Multi-currency payments and settlements |
| eWAY | Australian businesses | Local payment gateway and integrations |


### 1\. Stripe — my overall recommendation

![MXSCENT 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/w7aHB5oj3RvuzQW0TjWXIdvL_OI6vRhcixpnL6avJE49eedijUd451ovcUEEJBRvuTQuLvThiaaYEPYMP470bs9BE3-prqlDurorjm4XaVCLdATr1odEiGFmrE-K6wfU3W5chhjW3JAPC2I4xjrz5IJR127qnps3DkauSMmMtYCIuNlOXXstMrqnFE74v_2R?purpose=fullsize)

**Stripe**

Best all-round online payment processor

My first choice for most independent online stores

- Accepts major credit and debit cards.
- Supports Apple Pay and Google Pay.
- Subscription and recurring payments.
- Fraud prevention tools.
- Integrates with many ecommerce platforms.
- No standard monthly processing subscription.

Australian domestic card pricing is around 1.65% + \$0.30 per transaction in current published comparisons. International cards cost more. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[wise.com](https://wise.com/au/blog/best-ecommerce-payment-gateway?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[wise.com](https://wise.com/au/blog/best-small-business-payment-gateway-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Website: [stripe.com/au](https://stripe.com/au)

### 2\. Shopify Payments — best if you use Shopify

![Shopify Payments Expands to New Regions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lC04GkaJzdd7GzUg3qrNTKsBJPytHZiw4W5jwHoAvy1xVbT8V-egxbtqtSEW59dvbz2A_WQa1j0W-eh87GOdmwc5oB297oEMN3LV2BaWy6byEF69APas5TQ7KBWP80-KFBSyvhx89PhXXPfR1Nn0muF4d5ttok5ED6SVBKE6Cnz_BQmITM0jidH9amYIFhJF?purpose=fullsize)

**Shopify Payments**

Best for Shopify-based stores

- Integrated directly into your store.
- No separate payment gateway setup.
- Supports digital wallets.
- Centralised orders, payments and refunds.
- Avoids additional third-party transaction fees imposed by Shopify when using its own payment system.

Website: [shopify.com/au](https://www.shopify.com/au)

### 3\. Square — best for simple operations

![Square - Your Home for Office Supplies & Stationery in Australia | Office Choice](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/74RRr5FQDg1kNl2k-gQkIeUyL1rx8tBO-09mmrGR4IzzIo0ZQdUCoZA3rGRP_vx0jx4wvhHG-HaHXbDzdg7v-Mo03ssPKI-76ato0GW9aGrlDgtzisJ6qno9BXf4jjdHBPeTIXSm_hB4j-jel44FTxXoyluopi7jSCFytUECArOvvcMb7P0VgjbOFYdf_MIb?purpose=fullsize)

**Square**

Best if you also sell face-to-face

- Straightforward payment processing.
- Online and in-person sales.
- Inventory and sales tracking.
- Useful if you attend markets or operate a physical shop.

Published Australian online processing rates are around 2.2%. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[wise.com](https://wise.com/au/blog/best-ecommerce-payment-gateway?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[wise.com](https://wise.com/au/blog/best-small-business-payment-gateway-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Website: [squareup.com/au](https://squareup.com/au)

## What I'd choose

For a typical small Australian online store\:

1. **Stripe** as the primary payment processor.
2. **PayPal** as an additional checkout option.
3. **Apple Pay and Google Pay** enabled to make checkout easier.

You want to make it as easy as possible for customers to pay without creating unnecessary costs or complexity.

## Three questions to narrow it down

I can give you a much more precise recommendation if I know three things.

**1\. What platform is your online store using?**

**3\. Where are your customers located?**
